canonicalTaskIdentity.rule: An ID must be explicitly stored or come from an approved reversible export table. Source lines alone are not stable when a card moves.

fieldMapping.id: must be established by an approved reversible export table before cutover
fieldMapping.rawText: kanban card raw text, preserved byte-for-byte
fieldMapping.title: kanban card title, preserved without automatic renaming
fieldMapping.status: explicit approved column mapping only; unsupported columns fail closed
fieldMapping.checked: kanban checkbox state, independent from status
fieldMapping.tags: lexically extracted tags, preserved as an ordered list
fieldMapping.priority: null unless an approved explicit mapping exists
fieldMapping.owner: null unless an approved explicit mapping exists
fieldMapping.project: null unless an approved explicit mapping exists
fieldMapping.dependencies: empty only when none are represented; otherwise explicit mapping is required
fieldMapping.completedAt: preserve the parsed completion date or null
fieldMapping.subtasks: preserve nesting, text, checkbox state, tags, and completion date
fieldMapping.order: preserve column and ordinal order unless a later contract makes ordering non-authoritative
fieldMapping.sourceLocation: preserve source path, column, and original line

integrityRules.duplicates: Reject duplicate stable IDs and duplicate destination IDs.
integrityRules.conflicts: Reject any field difference for a shared stable ID.
integrityRules.loss: Reject a missing source stable ID or a destination-only stable ID.
integrityRules.unknownFields: Reject unsupported task-record fields rather than dropping them.
integrityRules.idempotency: A second migration result must equal the first result exactly.
integrityRules.rollback: The rollback result must equal the pre-cutover canonical record set exactly.
integrityRules.rendering: Rendering must be deterministic from canonical records; it cannot create another write authority.

cutoverCriteria: M1.3 is complete and task runtime behavior is stable.
One future authority model is selected by an existing or explicitly approved Mind contract.
Every current card has a stable ID backed by a reversible export table.
Every live source column has an approved status mapping.
Fixture equivalence, divergence, unknown-field, round-trip, idempotency, and rollback checks pass.
A human approves the exact snapshot hash, target, compatibility behavior, and rollback procedure.
No active producer writes during the local cutover.

postCutoverCompatibility.rule: Only the selected authority may be writable. All other surfaces are generated, read-only compatibility, or historical.
postCutoverCompatibility.deletionPrerequisite: No legacy surface may be removed until the selected authority, all compatibility readers, producer migration, and exact rollback proof are approved.

brainProducerInterface.current: No Brain producer may write a task representation while futureAuthority is null.
requiredBeforeBS010: one exact approved writable target path
conflict response that performs no write
